# Barn & Beam Creations

> Custom laser engraving and full-color UV printing studio in Buckner, Missouri (Kansas City metro), shipping nationwide.

## Business summary

Barn & Beam Creations (also written Barn and Beam Creations) produces custom laser-engraved and UV-printed products from client artwork and designs. Established 2025. Website: https://www.barn-beam.com/

## Core services

1. **Laser engraving** — Permanent, high-precision detail on wood, leather, acrylic, metal, glass, and more (logos, names, fine line art).
2. **UV printing** — Durable full-color prints on hard goods (drinkware, hat patches, plaques, promotional products).
3. **Custom signage** — House signs, ranch boards, shop plaques, display pieces.
4. **Personalized gifts** — Cutting boards, coasters, hat patches, keychains, wedding keepsakes, event gifts.
5. **Business branding** — Logo engraving, branded merchandise, client gifts.
6. **Custom projects** — Material selection, sizing, and process guidance for unique ideas.

## Materials

Wood, metal, acrylic, leather, glass, fabric, hats/patches, drinkware, and other surfaces suitable for laser or UV production.

## How to order

1. Share a design or project description (artwork upload or written brief).
2. Choose materials and process (laser vs UV) with shop guidance.
3. Production with quality checks.
4. Ship or local pickup in Buckner, MO.

Typical quote response time: 1–2 business days after inquiry.

## Ideal customers / use cases

- Small businesses needing branded merch or client gifts
- Weddings and personal milestones (engraved glassware, keepsakes)
- Events and teams (hat patches, giveaways)
- Home and ranch signage
- Anyone needing one-off or small-run custom engraving/printing
